qualification: Essential: Master's degree (M.Sc.) in Botany from a UGC-recognized university with at least 55% aggregate marks at the time of submitting the application. || Desirable: M.Sc. in Botany with specialization in Plant Taxonomy or Plant Systematics (any plant group), working knowledge of computers, strong analytical abilities, and proficient technical writing skills. || Candidates who have qualified CSIR-JRF NET are exempted from the written examination. However, they must still apply, select their preferred examination centres, and appear for the interview if shortlisted.
age_limit: 28 years (as on last date of application submission)
application_fee: Fees must be paid only through bharatkosh.gov.in using the "Quick Pay" option, selecting Ministry/Department as "079 - Environment and Forests," Purpose as "Exam Fees," PAO as "075020-PAO(BSI/ZSI), Kolkata," and DDO as "275023-Director." Candidates must download the payment receipt from the Bharatkosh website and retain it, since the receipt number and date must also be entered in the application form.
selection_process: A physical (offline) written test consisting of one Multiple Choice Question (MCQ) paper of 3 hours duration will be conducted across all Regional Centres of BSI. The exact date and time will be communicated in advance and posted on the official website. || Online interviews for shortlisted candidates will be hosted through five regional centres: Central National Herbarium (Howrah), Eastern Regional Centre (Shillong), Western Regional Centre (Pune), Southern Regional Centre (Coimbatore), and Northern Regional Centre (Dehradun). || Regional centre allocation depends on applicant turnout; if turnout at a specific centre is too low, candidates will be shifted to the nearest regional centre. The Director, BSI, reserves the right to centralize all interviews at a single location.

board: BARC Vacancy 2026 - 06 Scientific Assistant PostsBARC Scientific Assistant Vacancy 2026
title: Scientific Assistant/C (Psychologist), Scientific Assistant/B (Pathology), Scientific Assistant/B (Radiography), Scientific Assistant/B (Nuclear Medicine Technologist)
qualification: Graduation in Psychology with minimum 60% marks, PLUS Post Graduation in Applied Psychology/Psychology with specialization in Clinical Psychology or Counselling Psychology with minimum 50% marks. Minimum one year Hospital/Clinical experience after acquiring the postgraduate degree will be given preference.
salary: In addition to entry pay, allowances will be admissible under Central Government Rules. Additional benefits include an exciting working environment, promotions under DAE's Merit Promotion Scheme, healthcare for self and family members, attractive performance-related incentives, professional update allowance, Leave Travel Concession, Children Education Allowance, and Departmental Accommodation as per Government of India Orders. Selected candidates will be governed by the National Pension System (NPS) or Unified Pension Scheme (UPS) as per Government orders.
age_limit: Age is calculated as on the closing date, 18.08.2026. Only the Date of Birth indicated in the School Leaving Certificate or equivalent certificate will be accepted; no subsequent request for change will be granted. || Upper age relaxation is admissible as follows: || Departmental candidates with at least 3 years of continuous and regular service in the same line or allied cadre as on the last date of receipt of application, as per Government of India Orders. || 5 years' relaxation for children/family members of those who died in the 1984 Riots. || Widows, divorced women, and women judicially separated from their husbands and not re-married, as per Government of India Orders. || Meritorious sportspersons, as per Government of India Orders. || The notification does not specify separate age relaxation figures for SC/ST/OBC/PwBD categories; candidates claiming any age relaxation must produce documentary proof.
application_fee: Mode of payment is online only, through the "Make Payment" option under the "My Account" menu after the application number is generated. || Fee not paid on or before the closing date (18.08.2026) will make the application incomplete, and it will be rejected. || Fee once paid will not be refunded under any circumstances and cannot be held in reserve for any other recruitment. || If applying for more than one post, application and fee must be submitted separately for each post.
selection_process: Selection for all four posts (DR/01 to DR/04) will be based on performance in a personal interview. If the number of applications received is high, BARC reserves the right to restrict the number of candidates called for interview by conducting a screening test in the respective discipline. The decision of the Centre in this regard will be final and binding.
